profile.headline: Agentic AI at Expedia | MS CS at CSUF | Tech Enthusiast
profile.summary:
I am a self-driven, passionate, and curious soul with keen interest in learning new technologies. A fast learner who is keen on learning and contributing to the development of an organization by using technical knowledge. I have experience in Full Stack software development and Database Management, with strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and computing fundamentals.

I strongly believe that teamwork, effective communication, and efficient team collaboration are equally important for a team's success apart from technical expertise. 

I am looking forward to utilizing my technical expertise and collaborative mindset to develop exciting technology products that can make an impact and contribute to the organization's success. Please feel free to reach out via email at ritup2054@gmail.com for any further information.
